(Delver). Card advantage: ending up with more resources than the opponent. Cantrip: a cheap spell
that replaces itself (Brainstorm, Ponder, Preordain) — chains dig you to your key cards. Combo:
assemble a specific interaction to win outside combat (Storm, Sneak & Show). Prison/lock:
denying the opponent resources (Lands' Tabernacle + Wasteland).
Keywords: Storm (copies the spell once per spell cast this turn — cast the cheap enablers FIRST,
count storm before the payoff). Delve (exile graveyard cards to pay generic mana). Cascade /
Prowess / Flash / Flying / Trample / Deathtouch / Lifelink / Hexproof / Shroud (untargetable) /
Infect (deals damage as -1/-1 counters to creatures and POISON to players; 10 poison kills).
Energy: a counter resource spent by Mardu Energy payoffs. Reanimate: cheat a big creature from
the graveyard into play (Animate Dead, Reanimator) — sometimes DISCARDING the fatty is the setup,
not a loss. Miracle: cast a card for its cheaper cost the turn you draw it (Miracles/Terminus).
Archetypes in this pool: ANT/Storm (ritual mana -> Ad Nauseam -> lethal storm count; protect the
combo turn, count mana and storm exactly). Burn (Goblin Guide/Swiftspear + direct damage; every
point of reach to 0 matters, do not waste burn on blockers unless forced). Death & Taxes
(Thalia/Mother of Runes hatebears + Wasteland/Rishadan Port mana denial; tax and grind). Elves
(mana-dork snowball into Craterhoof-style overrun; develop then alpha strike). Goblins (Lackey/
Ringleader tribal aggro-value; recur bodies, go wide). Grixis Reanimator (discard + Animate Dead
on Atraxa/Archon early; find a target and an enabler, protect the turn). Infect (Glistener Elf/
Blighted Agent + pump; ONE connection near 10 poison is lethal — protect the creature, count
poison). Lands (Wasteland/Port + Tabernacle prison into Marit Lage; deny mana, grind inevitability).
Mardu Energy (aggressive energy payoffs; curve out, use energy at the right beat). Miracles
(Brainstorm/Ponder set up Terminus/Entreat wraths; control the board, win late). Sneak & Show
(Show and Tell / Sneak Attack a huge threat like Emrakul years early; force it through the counter
window). UR Delver (Delver of Secrets + cantrips + burn + counters; tempo — protect the clock,
counter their key spell, race).
General rule for all of them: know YOUR deck's win condition, advance it every turn, and use each
decision to protect the line that actually wins — not to react locally.

=== LEGACY GLOSSARY (mechanics + the eval-deck archetypes you will face) ===
Tempo: trading mana-efficiency and board presence for initiative — cheap threats + disruption
(Delver). Card advantage: ending up with more resources than the opponent. Cantrip: a cheap spell
that replaces itself (Brainstorm, Ponder, Preordain) — chains dig you to your key cards. Combo:
assemble a specific interaction to win outside combat (Storm, Sneak & Show). Prison/lock:
denying the opponent resources (Lands' Tabernacle + Wasteland).
Keywords: Storm (copies the spell once per spell cast this turn — cast the cheap enablers FIRST,
count storm before the payoff). Delve (exile graveyard cards to pay generic mana). Cascade /
Prowess / Flash / Flying / Trample / Deathtouch / Lifelink / Hexproof / Shroud (untargetable) /
Infect (deals damage as -1/-1 counters to creatures and POISON to players; 10 poison kills).
Energy: a counter resource spent by Mardu Energy payoffs. Reanimate: cheat a big creature from
the graveyard into play (Animate Dead, Reanimator) — sometimes DISCARDING the fatty is the setup,
not a loss. Miracle: cast a card for its cheaper cost the turn you draw it (Miracles/Terminus).
Archetypes in this pool: ANT/Storm (ritual mana -> Ad Nauseam -> lethal storm count; protect the
combo turn, count mana and storm exactly). Burn (Goblin Guide/Swiftspear + direct damage; every
point of reach to 0 matters, do not waste burn on blockers unless forced). Death & Taxes
(Thalia/Mother of Runes hatebears + Wasteland/Rishadan Port mana denial; tax and grind). Elves
(mana-dork snowball into Craterhoof-style overrun; develop then alpha strike). Goblins (Lackey/
Ringleader tribal aggro-value; recur bodies, go wide). Grixis Reanimator (discard + Animate Dead
on Atraxa/Archon early; find a target and an enabler, protect the turn). Infect (Glistener Elf/
Blighted Agent + pump; ONE connection near 10 poison is lethal — protect the creature, count
poison). Lands (Wasteland/Port + Tabernacle prison into Marit Lage; deny mana, grind inevitability).
Mardu Energy (aggressive energy payoffs; curve out, use energy at the right beat). Miracles
(Brainstorm/Ponder set up Terminus/Entreat wraths; control the board, win late). Sneak & Show
(Show and Tell / Sneak Attack a huge threat like Emrakul years early; force it through the counter
window). UR Delver (Delver of Secrets + cantrips + burn + counters; tempo — protect the clock,
counter their key spell, race).
General rule for all of them: know YOUR deck's win condition, advance it every turn, and use each
decision to protect the line that actually wins — not to react locally.

=== LEGACY GLOSSARY (mechanics + the eval-deck archetypes you will face) ===
Tempo: trading mana-efficiency and board presence for initiative — cheap threats + disruption
(Delver). Card advantage: ending up with more resources than the opponent. Cantrip: a cheap spell
that replaces itself (Brainstorm, Ponder, Preordain) — chains dig you to your key cards. Combo:
assemble a specific interaction to win outside combat (Storm, Sneak & Show). Prison/lock:
denying the opponent resources (Lands' Tabernacle + Wasteland).
Keywords: Storm (copies the spell once per spell cast this turn — cast the cheap enablers FIRST,
count storm before the payoff). Delve (exile graveyard cards to pay generic mana). Cascade /
Prowess / Flash / Flying / Trample / Deathtouch / Lifelink / Hexproof / Shroud (untargetable) /
Infect (deals damage as -1/-1 counters to creatures and POISON to players; 10 poison kills).
Energy: a counter resource spent by Mardu Energy payoffs. Reanimate: cheat a big creature from
the graveyard into play (Animate Dead, Reanimator) — sometimes DISCARDING the fatty is the setup,
not a loss. Miracle: cast a card for its cheaper cost the turn you draw it (Miracles/Terminus).
Archetypes in this pool: ANT/Storm (ritual mana -> Ad Nauseam -> lethal storm count; protect the
combo turn, count mana and storm exactly). Burn (Goblin Guide/Swiftspear + direct damage; every
point of reach to 0 matters, do not waste burn on blockers unless forced). Death & Taxes
(Thalia/Mother of Runes hatebears + Wasteland/Rishadan Port mana denial; tax and grind). Elves
(mana-dork snowball into Craterhoof-style overrun; develop then alpha strike). Goblins (Lackey/
Ringleader tribal aggro-value; recur bodies, go wide). Grixis Reanimator (discard + Animate Dead
on Atraxa/Archon early; find a target and an enabler, protect the turn). Infect (Glistener Elf/
Blighted Agent + pump; ONE connection near 10 poison is lethal — protect the creature, count
poison). Lands (Wasteland/Port + Tabernacle prison into Marit Lage; deny mana, grind inevitability).
Mardu Energy (aggressive energy payoffs; curve out, use energy at the right beat). Miracles
(Brainstorm/Ponder set up Terminus/Entreat wraths; control the board, win late). Sneak & Show
(Show and Tell / Sneak Attack a huge threat like Emrakul years early; force it through the counter
window). UR Delver (Delver of Secrets + cantrips + burn + counters; tempo — protect the clock,
counter their key spell, race).
General rule for all of them: know YOUR deck's win condition, advance it every turn, and use each
decision to protect the line that actually wins — not to react locally.

=== SNAPSHOT LEGEND (how to read the game state in each message) ===
Header `== Turn N PHASE (active: NAME) ==`: the turn number, current phase/step, and whose
turn it is. PHASE is one of UPKEEP, DRAW, MAIN1, COMBAT_BEGIN, COMBAT_DECLARE_ATTACKERS,
COMBAT_DECLARE_BLOCKERS, COMBAT_DAMAGE, MAIN2, END_OF_TURN, CLEANUP. `active:` is the player
whose turn it is — if it is not you, you are acting at instant speed on their turn.
`YOU [seat] life L | energy E, poison P/10`: your life total, then optional counters — `energy`
only shows when >0; `poison P/10` always shows (10 poison = you lose; infect/poison decks race it).
`hand(n): Name {cost} P/T (tag), ...`: your hand. `{cost}` is the mana cost in brace notation
(`{2}{B}` = two generic + one black; omitted for lands). `P/T` power/toughness shows for
creatures only. The affordability `(tag)` is a real payment check, not a guess: `(castable)` =
you can pay right now; `(need 1 more B)` = short exactly that color; `(not castable now)` = a
cost too complex to break down (hybrid/Phyrexian/X) or short on total mana.
`board: ...`: your NONLAND permanents (lands are summarized separately). Each: `Name(P/T)` for
creatures, `[loyalty N]` for planeswalkers, `[T]` = tapped, `[sick]` = summoning-sick (a creature
that cannot attack or use {T} abilities yet), and `[+1/+1 x2]`-style counters. `(no nonland
permanents)` means an empty board.
`lands: U untapped / T total (Name xU [untapped], Name xK [tapped])`: your land count and the
per-copy tap breakdown — duplicate-named lands are listed separately by tap state so you can
target the right copy.
`mana available: {U:2 R:1 C:1} (K untapped sources)`: how many untapped sources CAN make each
color right now (dual lands count in BOTH colors but can only make one at a time — a deliberate
over-count), and the count of distinct untapped mana permanents. Use it to check you can pay a
line before committing.
`yard(n): ...`: your graveyard (reanimator/delve/flashback fuel; dredge/escape enablers).
`OPP [name] life L ...`: the opponent's public state — board, lands, `mana available`, yard, and
`hand: N cards` (a COUNT only; their card identities are hidden unless INTEL revealed them).
Their untapped `mana available` is your read on open removal/counters — play around it.
`stack (top first): N pending: #k Name (player) -> targets | ...`: spells/abilities waiting to
resolve, top of stack first (it resolves first). `(empty)` means an open priority window with
nothing pending. `-> targets` shows what each is aimed at.
`RECENT EVENTS (oldest->newest)`: the engine's own log of what happened between your decisions
(opponent plays, combat results, discards). `INTEL: ...`: durable facts you learned (revealed
hands, cards you named). `YOUR TURN PLAN (...)`: the one-line plan you stated earlier this turn —
execute it or consciously deviate.

=== LEGACY GLOSSARY (mechanics + the eval-deck archetypes you will face) ===
Tempo: trading mana-efficiency and board presence for initiative — cheap threats + disruption
(Delver). Card advantage: ending up with more resources than the opponent. Cantrip: a cheap spell
that replaces itself (Brainstorm, Ponder, Preordain) — chains dig you to your key cards. Combo:
assemble a specific interaction to win outside combat (Storm, Sneak & Show). Prison/lock:
denying the opponent resources (Lands' Tabernacle + Wasteland).
Keywords: Storm (copies the spell once per spell cast this turn — cast the cheap enablers FIRST,
count storm before the payoff). Delve (exile graveyard cards to pay generic mana). Cascade /
Prowess / Flash / Flying / Trample / Deathtouch / Lifelink / Hexproof / Shroud (untargetable) /
Infect (deals damage as -1/-1 counters to creatures and POISON to players; 10 poison kills).
Energy: a counter resource spent by Mardu Energy payoffs. Reanimate: cheat a big creature from
the graveyard into play (Animate Dead, Reanimator) — sometimes DISCARDING the fatty is the setup,
not a loss. Miracle: cast a card for its cheaper cost the turn you draw it (Miracles/Terminus).
Archetypes in this pool: ANT/Storm (ritual mana -> Ad Nauseam -> lethal storm count; protect the
combo turn, count mana and storm exactly). Burn (Goblin Guide/Swiftspear + direct damage; every
point of reach to 0 matters, do not waste burn on blockers unless forced). Death & Taxes
(Thalia/Mother of Runes hatebears + Wasteland/Rishadan Port mana denial; tax and grind). Elves
(mana-dork snowball into Craterhoof-style overrun; develop then alpha strike). Goblins (Lackey/
Ringleader tribal aggro-value; recur bodies, go wide). Grixis Reanimator (discard + Animate Dead
on Atraxa/Archon early; find a target and an enabler, protect the turn). Infect (Glistener Elf/
Blighted Agent + pump; ONE connection near 10 poison is lethal — protect the creature, count
poison). Lands (Wasteland/Port + Tabernacle prison into Marit Lage; deny mana, grind inevitability).
Mardu Energy (aggressive energy payoffs; curve out, use energy at the right beat). Miracles
(Brainstorm/Ponder set up Terminus/Entreat wraths; control the board, win late). Sneak & Show
(Show and Tell / Sneak Attack a huge threat like Emrakul years early; force it through the counter
window). UR Delver (Delver of Secrets + cantrips + burn + counters; tempo — protect the clock,
counter their key spell, race).
General rule for all of them: know YOUR deck's win condition, advance it every turn, and use each
decision to protect the line that actually wins — not to react locally.

=== SNAPSHOT LEGEND (how to read the game state in each message) ===
Header `== Turn N PHASE (active: NAME) ==`: the turn number, current phase/step, and whose

COMBAT_DECLARE_BLOCKERS, COMBAT_DAMAGE, MAIN2, END_OF_TURN, CLEANUP. `active:` is the player
whose turn it is — if it is not you, you are acting at instant speed on their turn.
`YOU [seat] life L | energy E, poison P/10`: your life total, then optional counters — `energy`
only shows when >0; `poison P/10` always shows (10 poison = you lose; infect/poison decks race it).
`hand(n): Name {cost} P/T (tag), ...`: your hand. `{cost}` is the mana cost in brace notation
(`{2}{B}` = two generic + one black; omitted for lands). `P/T` power/toughness shows for
creatures only. The affordability `(tag)` is a real payment check, not a guess: `(castable)` =
you can pay right now; `(need 1 more B)` = short exactly that color; `(not castable now)` = a
cost too complex to break down (hybrid/Phyrexian/X) or short on total mana.
`board: ...`: your NONLAND permanents (lands are summarized separately). Each: `Name(P/T)` for
creatures, `[loyalty N]` for planeswalkers, `[T]` = tapped, `[sick]` = summoning-sick (a creature
that cannot attack or use {T} abilities yet), and `[+1/+1 x2]`-style counters. `(no nonland
permanents)` means an empty board.
`lands: U untapped / T total (Name xU [untapped], Name xK [tapped])`: your land count and the
per-copy tap breakdown — duplicate-named lands are listed separately by tap state so you can
target the right copy.
`mana available: {U:2 R:1 C:1} (K untapped sources)`: how many untapped sources CAN make each
color right now (dual lands count in BOTH colors but can only make one at a time — a deliberate
over-count), and the count of distinct untapped mana permanents. Use it to check you can pay a
line before committing.
`yard(n): ...`: your graveyard (reanimator/delve/flashback fuel; dredge/escape enablers).
`OPP [name] life L ...`: the opponent's public state — board, lands, `mana available`, yard, and

Their untapped `mana available` is your read on open removal/counters — play around it.
`stack (top first): N pending: #k Name (player) -> targets | ...`: spells/abilities waiting to
resolve, top of stack first (it resolves first). `(empty)` means an open priority window with
nothing pending. `-> targets` shows what each is aimed at.

(opponent plays, combat results, discards). `INTEL: ...`: durable facts you learned (revealed
hands, cards you named). `YOUR TURN PLAN (...)`: the one-line plan you stated earlier this turn —

=== LEGACY GLOSSARY (mechanics + the eval-deck archetypes you will face) ===
Tempo: trading mana-efficiency and board presence for initiative — cheap threats + disruption
(Delver). Card advantage: ending up with more resources than the opponent. Cantrip: a cheap spell
that replaces itself (Brainstorm, Ponder, Preordain) — chains dig you to your key cards. Combo:
assemble a specific interaction to win outside combat (Storm, Sneak & Show). Prison/lock:
denying the opponent resources (Lands' Tabernacle + Wasteland).
Keywords: Storm (copies the spell once per spell cast this turn — cast the cheap enablers FIRST,
count storm before the payoff). Delve (exile graveyard cards to pay generic mana). Cascade /
Prowess / Flash / Flying / Trample / Deathtouch / Lifelink / Hexproof / Shroud (untargetable) /
Infect (deals damage as -1/-1 counters to creatures and POISON to players; 10 poison kills).
Energy: a counter resource spent by Mardu Energy payoffs. Reanimate: cheat a big creature from
the graveyard into play (Animate Dead, Reanimator) — sometimes DISCARDING the fatty is the setup,
not a loss. Miracle: cast a card for its cheaper cost the turn you draw it (Miracles/Terminus).
Archetypes in this pool: ANT/Storm (ritual mana -> Ad Nauseam -> lethal storm count; protect the
combo turn, count mana and storm exactly). Burn (Goblin Guide/Swiftspear + direct damage; every
point of reach to 0 matters, do not waste burn on blockers unless forced). Death & Taxes
(Thalia/Mother of Runes hatebears + Wasteland/Rishadan Port mana denial; tax and grind). Elves
(mana-dork snowball into Craterhoof-style overrun; develop then alpha strike). Goblins (Lackey/
Ringleader tribal aggro-value; recur bodies, go wide). Grixis Reanimator (discard + Animate Dead
on Atraxa/Archon early; find a target and an enabler, protect the turn). Infect (Glistener Elf/
Blighted Agent + pump; ONE connection near 10 poison is lethal — protect the creature, count
poison). Lands (Wasteland/Port + Tabernacle prison into Marit Lage; deny mana, grind inevitability).
Mardu Energy (aggressive energy payoffs; curve out, use energy at the right beat). Miracles
(Brainstorm/Ponder set up Terminus/Entreat wraths; control the board, win late). Sneak & Show
(Show and Tell / Sneak Attack a huge threat like Emrakul years early; force it through the counter
window). UR Delver (Delver of Secrets + cantrips + burn + counters; tempo — protect the clock,
counter their key spell, race).
General rule for all of them: know YOUR deck's win condition, advance it every turn, and use each
decision to protect the line that actually wins — not to react locally.

=== SNAPSHOT LEGEND (how to read the game state in each message) ===
Header `== Turn N PHASE (active: NAME) ==`: the turn number, current phase/step, and whose
turn it is. PHASE is one of UPKEEP, DRAW, MAIN1, COMBAT_BEGIN, COMBAT_DECLARE_ATTACKERS,
COMBAT_DECLARE_BLOCKERS, COMBAT_DAMAGE, MAIN2, END_OF_TURN, CLEANUP. `active:` is the player
whose turn it is — if it is not you, you are acting at instant speed on their turn.
`YOU [seat] life L | energy E, poison P/10`: your life total, then optional counters — `energy`
only shows when >0; `poison P/10` always shows (10 poison = you lose; infect/poison decks race it).
`hand(n): Name {cost} P/T (tag), ...`: your hand. `{cost}` is the mana cost in brace notation
(`{2}{B}` = two generic + one black; omitted for lands). `P/T` power/toughness shows for
creatures only. The affordability `(tag)` is a real payment check, not a guess: `(castable)` =
you can pay right now; `(need 1 more B)` = short exactly that color; `(not castable now)` = a
cost too complex to break down (hybrid/Phyrexian/X) or short on total mana.
`board: ...`: your NONLAND permanents (lands are summarized separately). Each: `Name(P/T)` for
creatures, `[loyalty N]` for planeswalkers, `[T]` = tapped, `[sick]` = summoning-sick (a creature
that cannot attack or use {T} abilities yet), and `[+1/+1 x2]`-style counters. `(no nonland
permanents)` means an empty board.
`lands: U untapped / T total (Name xU [untapped], Name xK [tapped])`: your land count and the
per-copy tap breakdown — duplicate-named lands are listed separately by tap state so you can
target the right copy.
`mana available: {U:2 R:1 C:1} (K untapped sources)`: how many untapped sources CAN make each
color right now (dual lands count in BOTH colors but can only make one at a time — a deliberate
over-count), and the count of distinct untapped mana permanents. Use it to check you can pay a
line before committing.
`yard(n): ...`: your graveyard (reanimator/delve/flashback fuel; dredge/escape enablers).
`OPP [name] life L ...`: the opponent's public state — board, lands, `mana available`, yard, and
`hand: N cards` (a COUNT only; their card identities are hidden unless INTEL revealed them).
Their untapped `mana available` is your read on open removal/counters — play around it.
`stack (top first): N pending: #k Name (player) -> targets | ...`: spells/abilities waiting to
resolve, top of stack first (it resolves first). `(empty)` means an open priority window with
nothing pending. `-> targets` shows what each is aimed at.
`RECENT EVENTS (oldest->newest)`: the engine's own log of what happened between your decisions
(opponent plays, combat results, discards). `INTEL: ...`: durable facts you learned (revealed
hands, cards you named). `YOUR TURN PLAN (...)`: the one-line plan you stated earlier this turn —
execute it or consciously deviate.
Option lists label each card the same way: `Name (P/T)[loyalty N][tapped]/[untapped][counters]`,

=== LEGACY GLOSSARY (mechanics + the eval-deck archetypes you will face) ===
Tempo: trading mana-efficiency and board presence for initiative — cheap threats + disruption
(Delver). Card advantage: ending up with more resources than the opponent. Cantrip: a cheap spell
that replaces itself (Brainstorm, Ponder, Preordain) — chains dig you to your key cards. Combo:
assemble a specific interaction to win outside combat (Storm, Sneak & Show). Prison/lock:
denying the opponent resources (Lands' Tabernacle + Wasteland).
Keywords: Storm (copies the spell once per spell cast this turn — cast the cheap enablers FIRST,
count storm before the payoff). Delve (exile graveyard cards to pay generic mana). Cascade /
Prowess / Flash / Flying / Trample / Deathtouch / Lifelink / Hexproof / Shroud (untargetable) /
Infect (deals damage as -1/-1 counters to creatures and POISON to players; 10 poison kills).
Energy: a counter resource spent by Mardu Energy payoffs. Reanimate: cheat a big creature from
the graveyard into play (Animate Dead, Reanimator) — sometimes DISCARDING the fatty is the setup,
not a loss. Miracle: cast a card for its cheaper cost the turn you draw it (Miracles/Terminus).
Archetypes in this pool: ANT/Storm (ritual mana -> Ad Nauseam -> lethal storm count; protect the
combo turn, count mana and storm exactly). Burn (Goblin Guide/Swiftspear + direct damage; every
point of reach to 0 matters, do not waste burn on blockers unless forced). Death & Taxes
(Thalia/Mother of Runes hatebears + Wasteland/Rishadan Port mana denial; tax and grind). Elves
(mana-dork snowball into Craterhoof-style overrun; develop then alpha strike). Goblins (Lackey/
Ringleader tribal aggro-value; recur bodies, go wide). Grixis Reanimator (discard + Animate Dead
on Atraxa/Archon early; find a target and an enabler, protect the turn). Infect (Glistener Elf/
Blighted Agent + pump; ONE connection near 10 poison is lethal — protect the creature, count
poison). Lands (Wasteland/Port + Tabernacle prison into Marit Lage; deny mana, grind inevitability).
Mardu Energy (aggressive energy payoffs; curve out, use energy at the right beat). Miracles
(Brainstorm/Ponder set up Terminus/Entreat wraths; control the board, win late). Sneak & Show
(Show and Tell / Sneak Attack a huge threat like Emrakul years early; force it through the counter
window). UR Delver (Delver of Secrets + cantrips + burn + counters; tempo — protect the clock,
counter their key spell, race).
General rule for all of them: know YOUR deck's win condition, advance it every turn, and use each
decision to protect the line that actually wins — not to react locally.
